correctness.rationale: For 0<q<=1 the candidate has radial profile with positive first derivative and nonnegative second derivative, so its Levi form is positive semidefinite. It is independent of one complex direction, hence its top Monge-Ampere measure vanishes and it is maximal. It matches the boundary data exactly and lies strictly below the obstacle inside the ball; maximal comparison proves equality with the envelope. For q>1 the radial Levi eigenvalue becomes negative for s>1/q, proving failure of the same formula.
